lines.text: Fresh in our sources: an 8-K at 07:30 ET on October 1, 2026 reporting the bitcoin-backed PIPE transaction closed on September 30, a transaction earlier described as adding 3,170 Bitcoin, then valued above $200 million, with the purchase agreement contemplating 51,621,560 newly issued Class A PIPE shares; up 76.3% since the previous checkpoint and printed a new high of day. The desk reads it as a material change to the reported balance-sheet asset profile set against very large new equity issuance, with the September 30 closing capitalization table, the resale eligibility of the PIPE shares and the final per-share consideration and warrant terms not in our sources.

Fresh in our sources: a semi-annual filing (6-K at 20:31 ET on October 1, 2026) reporting first-half 2026 revenue down about 99.12% year over year with the discontinuation of low-margin cloud-platform resale, reliance on financing including convertible notes that may dilute on conversion, and a substantial loss for the period. The desk reads the revenue contraction, losses and potential conversion dilution as company-specific negatives, and nothing in our sources links the session's move to this filing or identifies a fresh favourable company event; up 17.2% since the previous checkpoint and printed a new high of day.

Fresh in our sources: a secondary headline at 08:08 ET on October 2, 2026 reporting Autonomix received Canadian Patent No. 3,183,802 for catheter-based nerve-treatment technology, with no underlying company announcement or patent document in the bundle. The desk reads it as broadening the reported intellectual-property coverage for that technology, the sort of item that can draw speculative interest, without evidence of near-term revenue or regulatory clearance and with no addressable market or licensing value quantified.

Fresh in our sources: secondary coverage at 08:31 ET on October 2, 2026 reporting Cycurion regained Nasdaq compliance, with no exchange notice or other primary-source record in the bundle, and a September 28, 2026 company release referring to an ongoing Nasdaq listing process. The desk reads regained compliance as removing a listing-status uncertainty if verified, but the report is secondary only, and the prior deficiency, the deadline and the conditions of compliance are not established in our sources.

No catalyst found in our sources: the October 1 company communications in the bundle (07:30 ET and 14:00 ET on October 1, 2026) are promotional items about media attention and the company's technology, with no contract, financing, regulatory approval or operating result stated, and a secondary report at 02:36 ET on October 2, 2026 described an after-hours rise without identifying a substantive event. The desk reads the communications as possibly raising attention but not identifying a material corporate event, and their full text and terms are not in the bundle.

No catalyst found in our sources: the latest items are a September 15 announcement (6-K at 16:30 ET on September 15, 2026) of a new website and logo tied to the stated AI-infrastructure transition and a September 9 sale of 3 million DOGE for approximately $267,665 of gross proceeds for working capital, with the September 3 name and ticker change not treated as a catalyst. The desk reads the company as presenting an AI-infrastructure transition while the DOGE sale was small and went to liquidity rather than a disclosed commercial milestone, and no primary-source company event after September 15, 2026 is in the bundle.

Fresh in our sources: a company release at 05:30 ET on October 2, 2026 (6-K at 06:15 ET) announcing a definitive agreement dated September 30 for the disposal of its Japanese business, including the wholly owned Japan holding company and the Mediagene and Infobahn subsidiaries, to a CEO-led acquisition vehicle for aggregate consideration of $5.5 million, with a special-committee process and a fairness opinion. The desk reads it as a concrete strategic divestiture rather than a promotional update, with closing conditions, expected closing date, use of proceeds and the sold business's financial contribution not in the bundle; down 13.5% since the previous checkpoint.

Fresh in our sources: a company-filed release at 12:06 ET on October 1, 2026 announcing a non-binding memorandum of understanding with Plume to explore an Asia-focused joint venture for structuring, issuing and distributing tokenized financial products. The desk reads it as tying SORA to the real-world-asset tokenization theme, with AsiaStrategy and Sora Ventures distribution across Asia cited for the proposed effort, while the non-binding status leaves execution and economics open and no financial or ownership terms, launch date, expected revenue or definitive agreement are in the bundle.

Not a fresh catalyst: our sources contain only the September 25 release (6-K at 16:04 ET on September 25, 2026) on the closed business combination, Nasdaq trading as GOW from September 28, and a completed $50 million closing PIPE of preferred shares and warrants alongside an earlier roughly $20 million private placement, for stated PIPE gross proceeds of $70 million before fees and expenses. The desk reads the listing as a visibility event and the PIPE as introducing preferred shares and warrants, with the number of securities issued, exercise terms, resale eligibility and any link between the September 25 closing and the current move not established; printed a new high of day since the previous checkpoint.
Not researched yet: no dossier is on file for LOCL at this checkpoint.

Fresh in our sources: a Schedule 13D dated October 1, 2026, with secondary coverage reporting Alpine Fox Capital disclosed a roughly 21.5% stake in Sono Group, and a premarket report at 06:06 ET on October 2, 2026 associating the disclosure with the shares up about 13% premarket. The desk reads a newly disclosed large holder as a development that can focus attention and may be viewed as supportive, while the 13D in the bundle carries no substantive excerpt, so the exact share count, acquisition dates, price and stated purpose, and whether the stake reflects recent open-market accumulation or securities acquired earlier, are not established; printed a new high of day since the previous checkpoint.

No catalyst found in our sources: the latest items are a September 29, 2026 8-K (12:17 ET) and company release (16:20 ET) acknowledging unusual trading activity and stating the company knew of no material development or other reason for it, plus a secondary report at 15:02 ET the same day. The desk reads the company as not attributing that activity to any newly disclosed operating development, and what caused it is not established in our sources.
